The '''345th Spira Regatta Open''' was held on [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Playboy and socialite [[Seth Cambriel]] entered the race aboard his personal vessel, the ''[[Cambus Gale]]'', and placed almost last. Unknown to the race organizers, Cambriel was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], and had used the race as a cover to assist a team of Rebel agents in recovering supplies from the planet's oceans.
